name: toggle-group
title: ToggleGroup
description: Toggle buttons with one shared value, on Base UI's ToggleGroup: a segmented outline track or quiet ghost items, single or multiple selection, horizontal or vertical, in three density-aware sizes.
usage: Use ToggleGroup for a small set of options that apply at once and stay visible: the result view (grid, JSON, chart), cell alignment, which columns to show. Name the group with aria-label and give each ToggleGroupItem a value; without multiple, one item is pressed at a time (the user can release it, so check for an empty value), with multiple any number. Wire value and onValueChange for controlled state. Outline is a segmented control; ghost suits toolbars. For a choice inside a form that must have exactly one answer, use RadioGroup; for one on/off setting, ToggleButton or Switch.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled values of the pressed items.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when an item is pressed or released.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets several items be pressed at once.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lays the items out in a row or a column and sets which arrow keys move focus.

props.name: variant
props.description: Outline joins the items in one bordered track with dividers; ghost keeps them apart.

props.name: size
props.description: Item height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The group, role="group"; data-slot="toggle-group", data-variant, data-size, data-orientation and data-multiple name it.

parts.name: ToggleGroupItem
parts.description: One toggle of the group, with ToggleButton's look; value identifies it, aria-label names an icon-only one.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over an item: color.interactive.hover and color.fg.default.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A pressed item: color.interactive.selected and color.fg.default, aria-pressed="true".

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on an item: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every item ignores interaction, at opacity.disabled.

accessibility: The group is a <div role="group">; name it with aria-label (or aria-labelledby). Each item is a native <button> with aria-pressed.
Tab reaches the group once; arrow keys move between items (left and right, or up and down when vertical), Enter and Space press.
Pressed is shown by color.interactive.selected and color.fg.default, and announced by aria-pressed, not by colour alone.
Icon-only items need an aria-label each.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).
